title: Tripo vs Meshy?
author: ExpensiveDate597
selftext: Which one do you suggest for game dev and practical usage? I've tried couple things myself and Meshy generated better textures. What do you think?

comments.author: Felmeric
comments.body:
For me, Tripo is giving better results. It generated a model that closely resembled the image I passed in every time. Meshy seemed to take a lot more creative liberty with its models. I tried multiple times to get an exact match to the images I was passing in and none came out exactly like the image.

I've only used these for a single part of one project so it's not an in depth review.

replies.author: ExpensiveDate597
replies.body: I've asked both Tripo and Meshy to create a basic stylized character. I found Meshy textures are a lot consistent accurate to the reference and PBR textures were really good. Tripo had issues since it baked the reflection in the reference to the model texture and the perspective that is made by Tripo was a lot less in detail and accuracy compared to Meshy. I checked recent youtube videos and all of them were sponsored by the Tripo. I'm just looking for different opinions.
